equipment.overview: A flexible femtosecond pump–probe platform. Spectral separation between pump and probe channels improves rejection of scattered pump light, while a mechanical delay line resolves the transient response from sub-nanosecond heat flow to acoustic echoes.
equipment.overviewZh: 基于飞秒泵浦-探测的柔性平台。泵浦与探测通道的光谱分离可抑制泵浦散射背景，机械延迟线同时覆盖亚纳秒热输运响应与声学回波。
equipment.principle: Complementary edge filters select different spectral bands from one femtosecond laser for pump and probe, suppressing scattered pump light. The modulated pump heats the transducer; delayed probe reflectance tracks cooling. A multilayer thermal model fits the lock-in signal ratio to extract conductivity or interface conductance when sensitivity permits.
equipment.principleZh: 利用互补边缘滤光片，从同一飞秒激光光谱中选取不同波段作为泵浦光和探测光，抑制泵浦散射串扰。调制泵浦加热金属传感层，延迟探测光读取冷却过程中的反射率变化；在灵敏度允许时，用多层导热模型拟合锁相信号比，提取热导率或界面热导。

equipment.overview: A second femtosecond TDTR line with wavelength-separated pump and probe optics. Independent optical channels support flexible filtering and detector selection for samples with different transducer reflectance and optical backgrounds.
equipment.overviewZh: 第二套飞秒 TDTR 光路采用波长分离的泵浦与探测通道，可根据不同金属传感层的反射率和光学背景灵活配置滤光与探测器。
equipment.principle: Pump and probe use distinct wavelengths, separated by wavelength-selective optics. Pump pulses heat the transducer; the probe samples reflectance at controlled delays. Model fitting extracts thermal properties within the sample's sensitivity window. Wavelength separation reduces pump leakage but does not eliminate fluorescence or all optical backgrounds.
equipment.principleZh: 泵浦与探测光采用不同波长，并通过选波光学元件分离。泵浦脉冲加热金属传感层，探测光在受控延迟下读取反射率变化；结合热模型，在样品灵敏度窗口内反演热物性。波长分离可降低泵浦串扰，但不能保证消除荧光等全部光学背景。

equipment.principle: A continuous-wave pump, or modulation slow enough for quasi-steady heating, raises the transducer temperature. The probe measures thermoreflectance versus absorbed pump power. equipment.principle: Inelastic light scattering probes lattice vibrations. Calibrated peak shifts, linewidths or anti-Stokes/Stokes ratios can indicate temperature; strain also shifts or splits peaks. Temperature and stress therefore require suitable mode-specific calibration or independent constraints. Probe-laser heating must be assessed before spatial mapping.
equipment.principleZh: 非弹性光散射探测晶格振动。经标定的峰位、线宽或反斯托克斯／斯托克斯强度比可用于测温，应变也会引起峰移或劈裂。温度与应力需通过适当的模态标定或独立约束区分，空间扫描前还需评估探测激光自身的加热。

equipment.principle: Scanning the lateral pump–probe separation measures a spatial thermoreflectance profile. Its width and shape depend on lateral heat diffusion, beam sizes and modulation conditions. An anisotropic heat-flow model, using scans along selected directions, constrains in-plane conductivity; anisotropy does not inherently shift the profile peak.

equipment.principle: A transducer drives pressure oscillations in the cleaning liquid. Cavitation bubbles grow and collapse, producing local shear, shock waves and near-surface microjets that dislodge contaminants. Cleaning also depends on solvent chemistry; excessive cavitation can damage fragile films or structures.
equipment.principleZh: 换能器在清洗液中产生超声压力振荡，空化气泡生长并塌缩，形成局部剪切、冲击波与近表面微射流，剥离污染物。清洗效果还取决于清洗液化学性质，过强空化可能损伤脆弱薄膜或结构。

For steady single-phase flow, mass flow and inlet/outlet temperatures give removed heat after heat-loss corrections. Chip temperature gives thermal resistance; extracting a heat-transfer coefficient also requires wall-to-fluid temperature and area. Pressure drop determines hydraulic pumping power.
equipment.principleZh: 热量由芯片传导至通道壁，再通过对流传给冷却液。稳态单相流下，结合质量流量与进出口温差，并修正散热损失，可求移除热量。芯片温升用于计算热阻；换热系数还需要壁面–流体温差与换热面积。压降决定液压泵功。

news.title: Thermal conduction in doped 3C-SiC published in Applied Physics Reviews
news.titleZh: 掺杂 3C-SiC 热输运研究发表于 Applied Physics Reviews
news.body: The group's work on thermal conduction in doped 3C-SiC has been published in Applied Physics Reviews. The study experimentally reveals the effect of resonant phonon scattering on thermal transport, deepening the understanding of heat conduction in wide-bandgap semiconductors. With a thermal conductivity second only to diamond among large-wafer materials, together with full compatibility with silicon processing, 3C-SiC is a promising candidate material for through-silicon via (TSV) applications in advanced integration.
news.bodyZh: 课题组关于掺杂 3C-SiC 热输运的研究成果发表于 Applied Physics Reviews。该研究实验揭示了共振声子散射对热输运的影响，深化了对宽禁带半导体热传导机制的理解。3C-SiC 热导率在大尺寸晶圆材料中仅次于金刚石，且与硅工艺完全兼容，是先进集成中硅通孔（TSV）应用的理想候选材料。

news.title: Group's first IEDM paper: 3D thermal conductivity mapping of advanced interconnects
news.titleZh: 课题组首篇 IEDM 论文：先进工艺节点互连层三维导热系数分布的高精度测量
news.body: At the 2025 IEEE International Electron Devices Meeting (IEDM) — the group's first paper at the conference — we presented high-precision, layer-by-layer measurements of interconnect thermal conductivity across advanced logic process nodes from 28 nm down to 3 nm. Combining advanced sample preparation with high-resolution thermal characterization and thermal scanning, we mapped the in-layer spatial distribution of thermal conductivity for the first time. The results show effective thermal conductivities of only about 1 W/m-K — far below copper (~400 W/m-K) — with Cu/dielectric interface thermal resistance (60–80 m²-K/GW) dominating heat transport. Guided by these findings, finite-element simulations propose high-thermal-conductivity AlN bonding layers, diamond heat spreaders, and high-convection cooling to keep 3D-stacked transistors within acceptable temperature rise. Zifeng Huang and Yiyun He are co-first authors, and Zhe Cheng is the corresponding author.
news.bodyZh: 在 2025 年 IEEE 国际电子器件会议（IEDM）上，课题组发表了首篇 IEDM 论文，首次实现对 28 nm–3 nm 先进制程节点芯片互连层导热系数的逐层高精度测量，并结合热扫描技术获得互连层内导热系数的空间分布。结果表明，各互连层有效导热系数仅约 1 W/m-K，远低于铜的本征值（约 400 W/m-K），铜/介质界面热阻（约 60–80 m²-K/GW）在互连层热输运中占据主导地位。基于这一认识，有限元热仿真提出引入高导热氮化铝键合层、金刚石均热结构并配合高对流换热散热，使超微缩三维堆叠晶体管保持可接受的温升水平。博士生黄子丰和何宜芸为共同第一作者，程哲研究员为通讯作者。

index.zh: 面向下一代集成电路研究者的协作型实验室

index.en: We welcome motivated students and young researchers from integrated circuits, electronic engineering, materials science, physics, mechanical engineering, energy science, and related fields.
index.zh: 我们欢迎来自集成电路、电子信息、材料、物理、机械、能源等相关领域的学生与青年学者加入。

index.en: Let’s address the thermal challenges of integrated electronics
index.zh: 共同应对集成电子系统的热学挑战

about.zh: 面向先进集成的热通路

about.en: Building efficient thermal pathways for advanced integrated circuits
about.zh: 为先进集成电路构建高效热通路

about.en: We investigate how heat is generated and transported across materials, interfaces, devices, interconnects, and package structures in high-performance chips, heterogeneous integration, and advanced packaging. We develop high-thermal-conductivity materials, interface engineering, advanced thermal characterization, and thermal-management technologies for three-dimensional integration.
about.zh: 我们面向高性能芯片、异质集成与先进封装，研究热量在材料、界面、器件、互连和封装结构中的产生与传递，并发展高导热材料、界面调控、先进热表征和三维集成热管理技术。

about.en: Thermal management is becoming a core constraint on integration
about.zh: 热管理正在成为集成技术的核心约束

about.en: As chips move toward higher power density and greater integration, thermal challenges shift from external cooling into the chip structure. Local hotspots, inter-layer thermal coupling, interface resistance, and constrained vertical pathways jointly affect performance, reliability, and integration architecture.
about.zh: 随着芯片向更高功率密度和更高集成度发展，热问题已经从外部散热进入芯片结构内部。局部热点、层间热耦合、界面热阻和受限的垂直热通路，共同影响芯片的性能、可靠性与集成方式。

about.en: In 2.5D and 3D systems, materials, interconnect structures, bonding processes, and package architectures together determine total thermal resistance. Thermal management has therefore become an integral part of advanced integration technology.
about.zh: 在2.5D与3D集成系统中，材料选择、互连结构、键合工艺和封装架构同时决定最终热阻。热管理因此成为先进集成技术的重要组成部分。

about.en: Lower thermal resistance supports more usable power and computing performance.
about.zh: 更低的热阻，支持更高的可用功率与计算性能。

about.en: Research system from materials to 3D integration
about.zh: 从材料到3D集成的研究体系

about.en: Growth, thermal transport, and size effects in high-thermal-conductivity semiconductors and heat-spreading materials, including diamond, AlN, SiC, and related materials.
about.zh: 研究高导热半导体与热扩散材料的生长、热输运和尺寸效应，关注金刚石、AlN、SiC及相关材料在芯片热管理中的应用。

about.en: Heat transfer across heterogeneous interfaces, buried interfaces, and bonding layers, with emphasis on how interfacial structure and processing determine thermal resistance.
about.zh: 研究异质材料界面、埋层界面和键合层中的热传递，揭示界面结构与制备工艺对热阻的影响。

about.en: Local hotspots in micro- and nanoelectronic devices, effective thermal conductivity of BEOL and advanced interconnects, and heat-spreading paths in complex device structures.
about.zh: 研究微纳电子器件中的局部热点、BEOL与先进互连的有效热导率，以及复杂器件结构中的热扩散路径。

about.en: Co-design of heat-spreading layers, high-conductivity pathways, and package structures for chiplet integration, 3D stacking, and advanced packaging.
about.zh: 面向芯粒集成、三维堆叠和先进封装，探索热扩散层、高导热通路与封装结构协同设计，提升集成系统的散热能力与可靠性。

about.en: TDTR, FDTR, SSTR, and thermal imaging in real process structures
about.zh: TDTR、FDTR、SSTR及热成像，获得真实工艺结构热参数

about.en: Heat-transfer models, sensitivity analysis, atomic-scale characterization, and uncertainty
about.zh: 传热模型、敏感度分析、原子级表征与不确定性评估

about.en: High-conductivity materials, interface engineering, heat spreaders, and local pathways
about.zh: 高导热材料、界面工程、热扩散层与局部热通路设计

about.en: Heterogeneous integration, 3D stacking, and advanced packaging
about.zh: 将材料与界面研究转化到异质集成、三维堆叠与先进封装

about.en: Experimental verification feeds the next design cycle
about.zh: 通过实验验证热管理效果，进入下一轮优化

about.en: A 3D-IC places chiplets, interconnects, and bonding interfaces within a confined volume. Every layer and interface can limit the thermal pathway.
about.zh: 3D-IC将多个芯粒、互连和键合界面集成在有限空间内。每一层材料和每一个界面都可能成为热通路中的限制因素。

about.en: Move through the questions to trace thermal bottlenecks across the stack.
about.zh: 浏览右侧问题，逐层查看3D-IC中的热瓶颈。

about.en: Can high-thermal-conductivity films retain their material advantage at device-relevant thicknesses, and how do grain boundaries, dimensions, and defects change thermal conductivity?
about.zh: 高导热薄膜能否在实际厚度下保持材料优势？晶界、尺寸和缺陷如何影响薄膜热导率？

about.en: How do local hotspots and thermal coupling between chiplets affect performance and reliability?
about.zh: 局部热点和不同芯粒之间的热耦合如何影响性能与可靠性？

about.en: How do advanced interconnects and low-k dielectrics change the effective vertical thermal pathway?
about.zh: 先进互连和低介电常数材料如何改变垂直热通路与有效热导率？

about.en: Does the bonding interface become a dominant thermal resistance in the stack?
about.zh: 混合键合界面是否构成热通路中的主要热阻？

about.en: How can heat-spreading layers and high-conductivity pathways be embedded in 3D-ICs to improve system-level heat dissipation?
about.zh: 热扩散层和高导热通路如何嵌入3D-IC，并提升跨层热通路与系统散热能力？

about.en: Advanced thermal-characterization platform supporting the research
about.zh: 支撑研究的先进热表征平台

about.en: Advanced thermal characterization is a core research capability for developing thermal-management and integration technologies. The platform combines optical thermal metrology, thermal imaging, customized model fitting, and automated data processing to study and validate materials, devices, interconnects, and packages.
about.zh: 先进热表征是实验室发展热管理与集成技术的核心研究能力。平台集成多种光学热测量系统、热成像技术、定制化模型拟合与自动化数据处理，支持材料、器件、互连和封装结构的研究与验证。

about.en: Connecting thermal science with integrated-circuit technology
about.zh: 连接热科学与集成电路技术

about.en: We develop a complete research chain spanning heat-transport mechanisms, advanced characterization, materials and interface control, heterogeneous integration, and advanced-packaging applications to deliver verifiable thermal-management technologies for high-performance integrated circuits.
about.zh: 我们致力于建立从热输运机理、先进表征和材料界面调控，到异质集成与先进封装应用的完整研究链路，为高性能集成电路提供可验证的热管理技术。

research.en: Research
research.zh: 研究方向

research.en: We develop thermal metrology and heat-transport engineering for next-generation integrated circuits, spanning high-thermal-conductivity materials, heterogeneous interfaces and bonding, and three-dimensional thermal tomography of interconnects.
research.zh: 我们面向下一代集成电路发展热测试方法与热输运调控技术，研究涵盖高导热散热材料、异质界面与键合，以及互连结构的三维热层析。

research.en: Research vision
research.zh: 研究愿景

research.en: As chip power density, integration density, and reliability requirements keep rising, heat transport across materials, interfaces, interconnects, and package structures becomes a central constraint for performance and lifetime.
research.zh: 随着芯片功率密度、集成密度和可靠性要求不断提升，材料、界面、互连与封装结构中的热输运正成为制约器件性能与寿命的核心因素。

research.en: Our research connects experimental thermal metrology — TDTR, FDTR, and Raman mapping — with materials growth, interface engineering, and physical modeling, targeting the structures that matter in real devices: diamond and SiC heat spreaders, bonded interfaces, and 3D-stacked interconnect layers.
research.zh: 我们的研究将 TDTR、FDTR 与 Raman mapping 等实验热测试手段与材料生长、界面工程和物理建模相结合，聚焦真实器件中的关键结构：金刚石与碳化硅热扩散材料、键合界面以及三维堆叠互连层。

research.en: Research thrusts
research.zh: 研究方向

research.zh: 高导热散热材料

research.zh: 异质界面与键合

research.en: 3C-SiC single-crystal wafer and Raman / XRD characterization (Nat. Commun. 2022)
research.zh: 3C-SiC 单晶晶圆及 Raman / XRD 表征（Nat. Commun. 2022）

research.en: Research Thrust 01
research.zh: 研究方向 01

research.en: High-thermal-conductivity heat-spreading materials
research.zh: 高导热散热材料

research.en: We grow and engineer wide-bandgap heat-spreading materials — diamond, 3C-SiC, and AlN — and tailor their thermal properties for integration with real devices.
research.zh: 我们生长并调控金刚石、3C-SiC、AlN 等宽禁带高导热材料，针对真实器件集成需求定制其热学性能。

research.en: Combining epitaxial growth, precision thermal metrology (TDTR / FDTR / Raman mapping), and theory, we turn grain size, doping, and interface structure into designable knobs for heat dissipation.
research.zh: 通过将外延生长、精密热测试（TDTR / FDTR / Raman mapping）与理论相结合，我们把晶粒尺寸、掺杂和界面结构转化为可设计的散热调控参量。

research.en: Wafer-scale single-crystal 3C-SiC with record in-plane and cross-plane thermal conductivity (Nat. Commun. 2022)
research.zh: 晶圆级单晶 3C-SiC，面内与面外热导率均创纪录（Nat. Commun. 2022）

research.en: SiC polytype boundaries with thermal boundary conductance above 2000 MW/m²·K — the highest reported to date
research.zh: SiC 多型体边界热导突破 2000 MW/m²·K，为迄今已知最高纪录

research.en: Low-temperature (<450 °C) BEOL-compatible diamond integrated on GaN transistors, cutting device temperature by 111 °C at 24 W/mm
research.zh: 低温（<450 °C）后道兼容金刚石集成于 GaN 晶体管，24 W/mm 功耗下器件温度下降 111 °C

research.en: B- and N-doped 3C-SiC with the largest thermal-conductivity tunability among common semiconductors
research.zh: B、N 掺杂 3C-SiC 实现常见半导体中最大的热导率可调范围

research.en: AlN films with intrinsic room-temperature thermal conductivity up to 321 W/m·K
research.zh: 本征 AlN 薄膜室温最高热导率达 321 W/m·K

research.en: Atomically resolved 3C-SiC/Si and AlN/3C-SiC interfaces (STEM)
research.zh: 原子分辨的 3C-SiC/Si 与 AlN/3C-SiC 界面（STEM）

research.en: Research Thrust 02
research.zh: 研究方向 02

research.en: Heterogeneous interfaces and bonding
research.zh: 异质界面与键合

research.en: Interfaces often dominate the thermal resistance of integrated devices. We study how atoms bond across them — and how to make bonded interfaces thermally transparent.
research.zh: 界面热阻常常主导集成器件的总热阻。我们研究原子如何跨越界面成键，以及如何让键合界面在热学上透明。

research.en: Using surface-activated bonding (SAB), annealing, and atomically engineered interlayers, we maximize thermal boundary conductance at semiconductor–semiconductor and semiconductor–dielectric interfaces, while revealing the underlying phonon physics with STEM-EELS, Raman spectroscopy, and machine-learned molecular dynamics.
research.zh: 我们利用表面活化键合（SAB）、退火工艺与原子级界面层设计，最大化半导体-半导体及半导体-介质界面的热导，并通过 STEM-EELS、拉曼光谱与机器学习分子动力学揭示其背后的声子物理。

research.en: Room-temperature GaN–diamond SAB bonding with 90 MW/m²·K interface thermal conductance (ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 2020)
research.zh: 室温 GaN-金刚石 SAB 键合，界面热导达 90 MW/m²·K（ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 2020）

research.en: Annealing-boosted GaN–diamond interface thermal conductance with a nearly 300% improvement (Adv. Electron. Mater. 2025)
research.zh: 退火使 GaN-金刚石界面热导提升近 300%（Adv. Electron. Mater. 2025）

research.en: AlN–SiC interface thermal conductance up to 800 MW/m²·K (arXiv:2602.13827)
research.zh: AlN-SiC 界面热导最高达 800 MW/m²·K（arXiv:2602.13827）

research.en: GaN-on-diamond with a high-thermal-conductivity 3C-SiC interlayer relieving thermal-expansion mismatch (Small 2024)
research.zh: 以高导热 3C-SiC 为中介层的 GaN-on-diamond 结构，缓解热膨胀失配（Small 2024）

research.en: From elastic phonon transmission at ideal Al–Al₂O₃ interfaces to interface phonon modes in Si–Ge — the physics that guides better bonding (Nat. Commun. 2020, 2021)
research.zh: 从理想 Al-Al₂O₃ 界面的弹性声子透射到 Si-Ge 界面局域声子模式——指导更优键合的物理机制（Nat. Commun. 2020, 2021）

research.en: Layer-by-layer 3D thermal-conductivity maps of production interconnect stacks
research.zh: 量产互连堆叠结构的逐层三维热导率分布图

research.en: Research Thrust 03
research.zh: 研究方向 03

research.en: Advanced interconnects and 3D thermal tomography
research.zh: 先进互连与三维热层析

research.en: Inside stacked chips, the interconnect stack is a thermal black box. We have developed 3D thermal tomography that experimentally maps the thermal-conductivity distribution of real interconnect layers, from 28 nm down to 3 nm process nodes.
research.zh: 在堆叠芯片内部，互连堆叠是一个热学“黑盒子”。我们发展了三维热层析技术，首次实验测得真实互连层的导热系数分布，覆盖 28 nm 至 3 nm 制程节点。

research.en: Combining P-FIB staircase preparation, aluminum sensor layers, and layer-by-layer TDTR scanning, we quantify how grain size, diffusion barriers, and interface resistance set the thermal bottleneck — and apply the same metrology to assess dielectric interface quality in hybrid bonding.
research.zh: 通过 P-FIB 阶梯制样、铝传感层与逐层 TDTR 扫描相结合，我们量化了晶粒尺寸、扩散阻挡层与界面热阻如何决定热瓶颈，并将同一测量方法用于评估混合键合中的介质界面质量。

research.en: First experimental measurement of 3D thermal-conductivity distribution in interconnect layers across 3–28 nm logic nodes (IEEE IEDM 2025, IEEE EDTM 2026)
research.zh: 首次实现 3–28 nm 逻辑节点互连层三维热导率分布的实验测量（IEEE IEDM 2025, IEEE EDTM 2026）

research.en: Layer-by-layer thermal maps revealing ultra-low conductivity of nanoscale interconnect layers and the dominant role of thermal boundary resistance (ACS Nano 2026)
research.zh: 逐层热学分布图揭示纳米互连层极低热导率与界面热阻的主导作用（ACS Nano 2026）

research.en: Three-dimensional TDTR scans exposing circuit-pattern effects on heat flow in production interconnect stacks
research.zh: 三维 TDTR 扫描揭示量产互连堆叠中电路图形对热流的影响

research.en: Thermal boundary conductance above 150 MW/m²·K as a metric for dielectric interface quality in hybrid bonding (Appl. Phys. Lett. 2026)
research.zh: 以高于 150 MW/m²·K 的界面热导评估混合键合介质界面质量（Appl. Phys. Lett. 2026）

facilities.en: The laboratory operates a comprehensive chip thermal-measurement platform with internationally advanced technical capabilities, covering nearly all major methods for chip thermophysical-property characterization and micro/nanoelectronic device thermometry. Supported by two National Key Laboratories in the School and process lines at leading domestic integrated-circuit companies, the platform targets the increasingly severe heat-dissipation bottlenecks and instrumentation-access challenges in next-generation 3D stacked devices and chips, as well as power and RF electronics.
facilities.zh: 实验室建有系统全面、技术世界前列的芯片热量测平台，基本上集齐了所有的芯片热物性和微纳器件测温设备。依托本学院两个全国重点实验室及国内头部集成电路企业工艺线，立志于解决下一代三维堆叠器件/堆叠芯片以及功率/射频芯片中日益严重的散热瓶颈和设备禁运问题。
